question: Where should the family spend the holidays this year?

parties.label: Maria
parties.text: We should host at our place because Mum can't travel easily anymore.

parties.label: Jon
parties.text: We hosted last year. It's our turn to rest, and I'm worried we'll burn out if we host again.

parties.label: Eve
parties.text: I'd like us to rotate fairly. Whoever hosts should get help with the cooking.
